📖 About the Book:
Chester and his best friend Wilson do *everything* their way — the same way, every single time. They like things just so, and they’re perfectly happy that way… until a new neighbor named Lilly moves in. She’s bold, different, and does things her *own* way — and suddenly, Chester and Wilson’s world gets a little more exciting (and a lot more fun)!

This sweet and funny classic from Kevin Henkes celebrates the joy of friendship, the courage to be yourself, and the magic that happens when you open your heart to someone new. 💕
